entries.title: Meadow Workshop Tool Rack
entries.description: Original freestanding timber tool rack with iron pins, hammer, wooden mallet and chisel. Each handle and tool head has modeled structural support.

entries.title: Meadow Village Water Point
entries.description: Original public water-point scene combining a hand pump, triple-arrow wayfinding post and recessed stone drain with iron grate on a cobbled plinth.

entries.title: Timber and Plaster Solid Wall, 2 m
entries.description: Independent S03 modular village wall: 2 m repeat, 2.6 m height, 0.22 m plaster core and two-sided timber details. Matching X-end plaster profiles with 2 mm top-rail installation seam. Central stud has a deliberate 10 mm face offset from the lower rail; short junction shadows are geometric rebates. Cottage v2 supplies the appearance reference, not a directly interchangeable building system. Static visual module; no structural, collision or navigation claims.

entries.title: Open Doorway Wall, 2 m
entries.description: Independent S03 modular village wall: 2 m repeat, 2.6 m height, 0.22 m plaster core and two-sided timber details. Matching X-end plaster profiles with 2 mm top-rail installation seam. Real open doorway, 0.98 m clear width and 2.05 m clear height measured above the 0.08 m threshold, with no door leaf. Cottage v2 supplies the appearance reference, not a directly interchangeable building system. Static visual module; no structural, collision or navigation claims.

entries.title: L-Corner Timber Wall, 2 m Interfaces
entries.description: Independent S03 L-corner wall with a continuous L-shaped plaster body and one owned corner post. Actual outer bounds are 2.14 by 2.14 by 2.60 m; matching terminal planes are X=2 m and Y=2 m, measured from the ground-level corner grid origin. Straight wall companions mount at (3,0,0) and (0,3,0), with the latter rotated 90 degrees. No doubled corner columns or nonuniform scaling required. Warm timber and pale plaster follow the S03 family. Cottage v2 is an appearance reference, not an interchangeable source. Static visual architecture;

entries.title: Deep Window Wall, 2 m
entries.description: Independent S03 2 m wall with a true 0.98 by 1.00 m framed window opening; sill top at local Z=1.00 m, recessed reveal and projecting stone sill. Matching straight-wall end profile and 2 mm combined timber seam. No glass or shutter included. Warm timber and pale plaster follow the S03 family. Cottage v2 is an appearance reference, not an interchangeable source. Static visual architecture;

entries.title: Clay Roof Section — 2m Repeat
entries.description: S03 modular clay gable-roof section with three restrained staggered courses per slope. Four-metre wall-centre span, two-metre Y repeat, explicit wall-cap mounting plane at local Z=0. Real opposite-face rafter/deck and ridge contacts with no forced interpenetration. Actual wall-cap and repeat-end contacts are recorded in local assembly evidence. Mounting origin is at wall-cap level; no terrain placement, structural load-capacity or runtime collision guarantee.

entries.title: Gable End — 4m Span
entries.description: S03 modular gable end with wall-cap base and a quarter-metre terminal clay roof strip meeting the repeating roof at local Y=0. Four-metre wall-centre span, quarter-metre outward terminal strip, explicit wall-cap mounting plane at local Z=0. Real opposite-face rafter/deck and ridge contacts with no forced interpenetration. Actual end-wall cap and repeating-roof mating evidence is retained for this visual module. No structural load-capacity or runtime collision guarantee.

entries.title: Stone Foundation — 2m Tile
entries.description: S03 modular stone foundation tile with a shallow inset lower course. Two-metre X/Y repeat and 0.30m flat full top for separately assembled wall modules. Real flat lower ground surface and positive opposite-face upper-course contacts. Visual game module, not a load-capacity or terrain-conformance guarantee.

entries.title: Timber Floor Kit — Five Fitting Profiles
entries.description: One S03 timber floor family supplied as five separately named mesh nodes with bottom-centre origins: Centre 2x2m, End 2x1.858m, Edge .858x2m, EdgeEnd .858x1.858m, and DoorEdge .858x2m with a 20mm threshold recess. Select a node and replace its display translation with its installation position; the spaced 4.5m display layout is not one floor tile. Finished panel height .08m matches the .38m doorway threshold when mounted on .30m stone foundations. True cut board widths retain the board pitch; variants are not five new asset types. See generate.py opening documentation for complete node selection, dimensions, coordinate conventions and unit-scale 4x8m shell coverage. Visual geometry only, no collision, accessibility or load guarantee.

entries.title: Low Timber Entry Landing
entries.description: Original S03 low timber entry landing, 2m wide by 1m deep. Five boards bear on two beams and four short ground blocks; finished surface .30m matches the existing stone apron, with a declared .08m rise to the doorway sill. The old .69m four-tier stair is not fitted or rescaled. Visual modular entrance platform, no navigation or accessibility guarantee.

entries.title: Low Two-Rise Stone Entrance Steps
entries.description: S03 continuous low stone stair: 1.20m wide, .60m deep, two .15m rises and .30m treads. Local +X rises toward a .30m landing, with a separate .08m doorway threshold rise unchanged. Actual closed profile, not a rescaled legacy stair. Visual interface only, no navigation, load or accessibility certification.

entries.title: Single-Slope Timber Entrance Canopy
entries.description: S03 four-post single-slope entrance canopy, mounted on the common .30m landing/apron top plane. Cut post heads and two sloping rails support the roof with six broad staggered clay groups. Covers the landing-to-door approach while remaining separate from the main eave. See generate.py opening documentation for exact host locations and installation axes. Visual geometry only; no load, accessibility or navigation certification.

entries.title: Fitted Timber Door Leaf
entries.description: S03 five-board fitted door for the .98x2.05m clear doorway in village-doorway-wall-2m-01. Mount at the host local origin with unit scale. HingeMounts_Static stays fixed; DoorLeaf_Runtime has the real hinge pivot(-.51,-.20,.08)m and editable local Z rotation. Seven discrete poses from0 to-90degrees in15degree steps checked; real polygon pin clearance and bearing support. No continuous motion, hardware simulation or accessibility guarantee.

entries.title: Paired Timber Window Shutters
entries.description: S03 paired three-board shutters for the .98x1m clear window in village-window-wall-2m-01. Mount at the host local origin with unit scale. HingeMounts_Static stays fixed. LeftShutter_Runtime/RightShutter_Runtime use real pivots(-.51,-.21,1)/(+.51,-.21,1)m. Nineteen discrete paired and single-leaf poses to90degrees checked, with real polygon pin clearance and bearing support. No continuous motion or hardware simulation guarantee.

entries.title: Two-Metre Soil Road Straight
entries.description: S03 continuous closed soil-road module with restrained earth and grass-shoulder zones. Nominal 2 m square, centre top .06 m, shallow rut bottoms .052 m, shoulders .02 m; matching actual end profiles, tested 2 mm installation seams. Use at unit scale; select appropriate straight or T routing. Approach to the separate .15 m first stair retains about 90–98 mm rise, then .30 m landing and .38 m doorway threshold. No navigation, accessibility or structural certification.

entries.title: Two-Metre Soil Road T Junction
entries.description: S03 continuous closed soil-road module with restrained earth and grass-shoulder zones. Nominal 2 m square, centre top .06 m, shallow rut bottoms .052 m, shoulders .02 m; matching actual end profiles, tested 2 mm installation seams. Use at unit scale; select appropriate straight or T routing. Approach to the separate .15 m first stair retains about 90–98 mm rise, then .30 m landing and .38 m doorway threshold. No navigation, accessibility or structural certification.

entries.title: Quarter-Turn Village Soil Road
entries.description: S03 compact quarter-turn soil path for village lanes and pedestrian environment layouts. One closed faceted quarter-sector with shared 2 m top-section ports, 1 m centreline radius, 2 m outer radius and restrained soil/grass shoulders. Place at unit scale; tested 2 mm installation gaps. No vehicle steering, navigation or accessibility guarantee.

entries.title: Rising Village Soil Road
entries.description: S03 closed earth road grade, 2 m long and 2 m wide with 0.5 m rise, maximum height 0.56 m. One continuous ground-supported embankment carries restrained soil and grass shoulders. Both top cross-sections match the 2 m flat-road family after the high end is raised 0.5 m. A high flat neighbour requires separate terrain support; demonstration support terrain is not included. Use unit scale and tested 2 mm seams. No navigation, accessibility, vehicle or engineering guarantee.

entries.title: Village Public Paving Kit
entries.description: S03 public paving family with two selectable unit-scale nodes: Paving_Core_2x2 (2 x 2 m) and Paving_Entry_0p5x2 (0.5 x 2 m). Each has a local bottom-centre origin; default separated translations are a selection layout, not one installed tile. See the opening documentation in generate.py for dimensions, node selection and the validated installation table. Real shallow stone-joint relief and a soil-road-profile entrance. One kit, without navigation, accessibility or engineering guarantees.

entries.title: Village Narrow Stone Border Kit
entries.description: S03 narrow planting-side stone boundary family with two selectable bottom-centre nodes: a 2 x 0.16 x 0.12 m straight and a 0.16 m clipped external corner. Unit-scale defaults are a separated selection layout. Full node selection, orientation and actual 2 mm interface installation table are in the opening documentation of generate.py. Boundary rises 60 mm above the matching public paving; keep entrances open. One family, without engineering or accessibility guarantees.

entries.title: Village Stone Box Culvert 2m
entries.description: S03 raised soil-road module with a small true stone-slab through channel. A 2 m road footprint matches existing rising-road high ends, with seven editable closed source parts and one static runtime mesh. Clear opening 0.34 x 0.24 m; its actual stone bottom is 0.06 m above the mounting plane. Overall depth includes 60 mm lining projections at both ends. See generate.py opening documentation for exact profile and placement. No water, navigation or structural performance guarantee.

entries.title: Independent Draped Cloth Awning
entries.description: Independent S03 draped cloth shelter with a continuous thick broad-fold canvas, four square posts and two real seating bars. Seven editable closed source parts export as one static runtime mesh. Overall 2.4 x 1.68 x 2.462 m. See generate.py opening documentation for origin, optional paving layout and finite geometric checks. Paving and reference figure are not included; no fabric simulation, load or weather guarantee

entries.title: Tied Harvest Grain Sheaf
entries.description: Static S03 tied grain sheaf with nine gathered cut stems, elongated overlapping seed heads and a small rope binding knot. Three solid PBR materials,86 editable closed source pieces and one assembled runtime mesh. See generate.py opening documentation for origin, unit-scale placement and finite geometric validation scope. Paving and shelter are not included; no crop species, rope simulation or balance guarantee
